name: Riojasuchus
sum: Riojasuchus is an ornithosuchid from the Late Triassic Los Colorados Formation of Argentina, one of the youngest and most complete members of its family.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: PVL 3827, a complete skull and mandibles and a nearly complete postcranial skeleton, collected in the late 1960s.
material: Four specimens: the holotype, PVL 3828 (almost as complete), PVL 3826 (vertebrae and limb fragments) and PVL 3814 (a few fragments).
biology: Ornithosuchids were facultatively bipedal and had adaptations for scavenging.
author: Bonaparte 1969

images.artist: Maria Belen von Baczko, Julia Brenda Desojo
images.caption: Skull of Riojasuchus.
